memories.title: Initial database preference
memories.content: Nora initially prefers Azure PostgreSQL for the AtlasPane Kubernetes dashboard because her team already has Azure credits.

memories.title: Offline-first goal
memories.content: AtlasPane must keep a local read-only cache so cluster status stays visible during a network outage.

memories.title: Database cloud changed to GCP
memories.content: Nora changed the current database target to GCP Cloud SQL because the launch customer moved the deployment to GKE.

memories.title: Latency budget
memories.content: The dashboard should keep p95 status-refresh latency below 900 milliseconds for clusters under 500 pods.

memories.title: Old alert color preference
memories.content: Earlier notes said restarted containers could use an amber border in the cluster list.

memories.title: Current alert color rule
memories.content: Nora updated the current UI rule: amber is only for degraded pods, while restarted containers should use a neutral gray indicator.

memories.title: Deferred feature
memories.content: The team postponed multi-cluster cost forecasting until after the first enterprise pilot.

memories.title: Pilot segment
memories.content: The first enterprise pilot targets platform teams that run regulated healthcare workloads.
